name: Q0302-223 field (Hubble)
blurb: A deep field toward the quasar Q0302-223, seen by Hubble.
label: q0302223-hubble
story: This field surrounds a distant quasar. A galaxy along the line of sight leaves a deep absorption mark in the quasar's light, known as a damped Lyman-alpha absorber, and Hubble looked here for that galaxy's faint starlight to learn about its stars and surroundings.

claims.text: HST program 13733 target Q0302 lies at RA 03 04 49.86, Dec -22 11 51.90, with a DLA galaxy at z=1.009
The quasar is Q0302-223 (RA 03:04:49.79, Dec -22:11:53.17), with a DLA at z = 1.009, imaged with WFC3 F105W and F160W in program 13733
A damped Lyman-alpha absorber lies toward quasar Q0302-223
The program aims to characterize the stellar content and environment of DLA galaxies by probing their faint optical continuum
